slides.scene: MOST DRAMATIC FRAME, overhead three-quarter view of the living-room floor during an indigo watercolor storm. Exactly Aachu and Zuv kneel on opposite sides of the now-unrolled single floor plan, separated by the paper but still inside the same pool of lamplight. The plan is blank except for one visibly tangled terracotta route line; it contains no words, icons or symbols. Aachu holds only her lower-left corner with her right hand while her left palm rests flat on her own thigh. Zuv holds only his lower-right corner with his left hand while his right palm rests flat on his own thigh. They are not fighting: both gaze at the same knot in the line with tired, honest bewilderment, shoulders lowered. Around them, the room's walls dissolve into rain-blue maze washes, but every body edge stays separate from furniture and paper. One practical lamp between them gives warm light without tinting the ivory paper. No touching across the map, pointing, shouting, tears, extra arms, extra people, reflections, letters, compass, heart or solution arrow. Reserve clean upper-left paper for exact copy.
